about: Moncton sits on a bend of the Petitcodiac River in southeastern New Brunswick. It is the province’s largest census metropolitan centre, a bilingual transportation and retail hub for the Maritimes, and the urban core of a three-city area with Dieppe and Riverview. The river’s tidal bore and Magnetic Hill are long-standing visitor draws. About 79,000 people live in Moncton.
